title: dzhng/jevgrep
why_read: A semantic code-search CLI built for AI coding agents, tackling the practical problem of finding relevant files by intent rather than exact text match.
analysis: Jevgrep is a command-line tool that lets you search a codebase by describing what code does in natural language rather than grepping for literal strings, intended to feed relevant context to coding agents. This fits into a growing category of tools trying to solve the 'context retrieval' problem for LLM-based coding assistants, which is one of the harder practical issues in making agents work on large codebases. It's a reasonably novel and useful niche tool, though it depends heavily on the quality of the underlying 'Jev' search/indexing technology, which isn't elaborated on here.
